clips.title: The story
paras: At Tarren Mill, Krusk coordinates the search for his captured scouts and the Syndicate's relics. Sent by Warchief Thrall to investigate Durnholde Keep, he survived an ambush that scattered his team.

Krusk leads the effort from Tarren Mill after a failed strike at Durnholde Keep. Warchief Thrall sent him and a small team to scout Syndicate activity and recover relics tied to the fortress's grim past. The human outlaws were more entrenched and coordinated than expected, and an ambush inside the crumbling walls overwhelmed the orcish scouts. Krusk fought his way out. Drull and Tog'thar were taken captive and locked within the ruins, while Gol'dir, the expedition's leader, was moved to another Syndicate hold. Krusk now directs Horde forces to breach Durnholde, recover the lost items, and free his trapped comrades.

From Tarren Mill, Krusk tracks the Syndicate's movements in Hillsbrad. The fallen nobles of Alterac operate from Durnholde Keep, plotting against Horde outposts and their former Alliance brethren. Krusk watches leaders such as Lord Aliden Perenolde, hoping to break their command before they threaten the Horde's tenuous foothold in Lordaeron.
